description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Stripe is dedicated to establishing a Product Sales team for Crypto/Stablecoins, aimed at empowering businesses to transform through our innovative platform.

Our global Product Sales team spearheads Stripe’s revenue and growth initiatives. As key business allies, we excel in guiding users to comprehend and seamlessly integrate Stripe products, enabling them to focus on their core business objectives. Known for our product expertise, analytical thinking, and user-centered problem-solving, we serve as a vital channel for user feedback and market insights, significantly impacting Stripe’s product direction and growth strategies.

As an Account Executive for Crypto/Stablecoins, you will leverage your sales and product expertise to drive the growth of Stripe’s stablecoin solutions across various customer segments. Collaborating with product, engineering, marketing, and other GTM teams, you will cultivate profound product and industry knowledge to manage complex deals. You are a skilled sales professional, comfortable with business-level and technical dialogues across diverse organizational tiers. You excel in competitive scenarios, passionately working on products demanding deep understanding and technical acumen. You thrive in client interactions as well as collaboration with internal teams, eager to master your expertise and share insights. An organized self-starter, your excellent communication skills, analytical prowess, and commitment to enhancing processes and organizations define your approach.

Responsibilities

• Drive revenue growth, enhance product attachment rates, and acquire new clients among SMBs, startups, and digital-savvy businesses.

• Establish relationships with key partners across all of APAC (GCN, SEA, SK, Japan, Singapore, Australia, and other relevant areas)

• Collaborate across the organization to tailor Stripe’s products and solutions to meet customer needs.

Who you are

Minimum requirements

• 8+ years of customer-facing experience at a leading technology or payments company, with a proven high performance record.

• Experience in establishing trusted advisory relationships with senior business leaders.

• Proven ability to foster strong collaborative interactions with cross-functional business partners.

• Autonomous, proactive approach to driving significant business outcomes.

• Enthusiastic, hands-on mentality.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: FDE Teaching Expert (Part-time)
description:
Description
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners - people with no prior tech background - through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: hosts the group live events, reviews the work, runs the solution design and delivery reviews, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.
This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run group live events, give real engineering feedback on student deployment deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.
Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.
Format: Group live events, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time - mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 15 to 25 hrs/week.
Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.
What you will do

• Host live events focused on deploying AI systems inside a client's environment: discovery and scoping, agentic architecture, integration with enterprise systems, rollout, and adoption.

• Run 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.

• Review student projects against rubrics, including the client-facing side of the work: scoping decisions, demos, and how they explain a system to a non-technical stakeholder.

• Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

Requirements

• 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).

• Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments - first call through production go-live and adoption.

• Depth across the FDE spine: customer discovery and design sessions, scoping and delivery planning under ambiguity, stakeholder management without formal authority; LLM and agent systems in production (prompting, tool/function calling, orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAI, guardrails, evals, RAG over enterprise data); APIs and integrations (REST, webhooks, JSON/GraphQL), Python, and deployment on at least one major cloud.

• Can explain why an architecture or scoping decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's work live.

• Strong technical communication: translating between technical and business audiences, comfortable leading a live session, whiteboarding a solution, and writing clear, specific review feedback.

• Strong English C1+ - instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.

• Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.

Preferred experience:

title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) Energieberatung für Hotels
description:
Sie begleiten Hoteliers als zentraler Ansprechpartner auf ihrem Weg in eine energieeffiziente Zukunft. In Ihrer Rolle führen Sie sie durch unseren strukturierten, mehrstufigen Beratungsprozess - vom ersten Strategiegespräch bis zur finalen Planung. Dabei übersetzen Sie technische Ergebnisse in verständliche Empfehlungen und schaffen so Klarheit und Vertrauen. Mit Kommunikationsgeschick, technischem Verständnis und Organisationstalent sorgen Sie dafür, dass jedes Projekt zielgerichtet und praxisnah umgesetzt wird.
Aufgaben

• Sie übernehmen die Leitung von Energieberatungsprojekten - vom ersten Kundenkontakt bis zur Übergabe der fertigen Planung.

• Sie führen Vor-Ort-Begehungen durch, analysieren den baulichen und technischen Ist-Zustand und erfassen relevante Details.

• Sie erklären Kunden klar und verständlich, welche energetischen Maßnahmen sinnvoll und wirtschaftlich sind - auf Basis der berechneten Ergebnisse.

• Sie führen Kunden durch unseren Beratungsprozess und begleiten sie mit verkäuferischem Geschick von Stufe zu Stufe.

• Sie präsentieren Ergebnisse strukturiert, nachvollziehbar und überzeugend - sowohl im Gespräch als auch in schriftlicher Form.

Qualifikation
Erforderlich:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen, Energieberatung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten - Sie können technische Inhalte verständlich und überzeugend erklären

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kunden, idealerweise mit verkäuferischer Verantwortung im beratenden Umfeld

• Technisches Verständnis für Gebäude, Haustechnik und energetische Zusammenhänge

• Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Vor-Ort-Terminen bei Hotelkunden (deutschlandweit)

Von Vorteil:

• Erfahrung in der Leitung von Energieberatungs- oder Bauprojekten

• Kenntnisse im Fördermittelwesen (BEG, KfW, BAFA)

• Erfahrung mit Energieberatersoftware wie Envisys oder vergleichbaren Tools

• Begeisterung für Nachhaltigkeit - besonders in der Hotellerie

Benefits

•
100 % Homeoffice mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung: Sie arbeiten vollständig remote und organisieren Ihre Arbeit eigenverantwortlich - ideal, um Beruf und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen.

•
Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung: Sie übernehmen eine Schlüsselrolle in unseren Projekten, bringen eigene Ideen ein und gestalten die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden aktiv mit.

•
Verlässliche Weiterentwicklung: Wir stellen Ihnen ein festes Weiterbildungsbudget zur Verfügung - für Seminare, Coachings oder Fachfortbildungen, die Sie beruflich und persönlich weiterbringen.

•
Erfolgsabhängige Vergütung: Je erfolgreicher Sie unsere Kunden durch den Beratungsprozess führen, desto stärker wirkt sich das auch auf Ihr Einkommen aus - Leistung zahlt sich bei uns aus.

•
Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einer zukunftssicheren Branche: Sie begleiten Hotels auf dem Weg in eine nachhaltigere Zukunft - und tragen damit aktiv zur Transformation der Branche bei.

•
Langfristige Perspektive: Bei gegenseitigem Interesse entwickeln wir Ihre Rolle weiter - mit wachsender Verantwortung und spannenden Projekten.

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!
Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die nicht nur fachlich überzeugt, sondern auch Freude daran hat, komplexe Inhalte einfach zu erklären, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Projekte mit Energie und Weitblick zum Erfolg zu führen. Wenn Sie gerne kommunizieren, strukturiert denken, pragmatisch handeln und sich in anspruchsvollen Aufgaben wohlfühlen, könnte das hier genau die richtige Stelle für Sie sein.

title: Compliance Analyst - Corrections
description:
Who we are:

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company.  Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service.  With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S. healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

• Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new. 

• Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward-always.

• Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job summary:

description:
About Mozn

If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.
About the role
We're hiring an AI Senior SRE: someone who carries a normal SRE workload - on-call rotation, incident response, root cause analysis, hands-on Kubernetes/cloud work - and builds the agentic layer that automates that workload over time. You are not exempt from operating production. You're the person best placed to know what should be automated, because you're the one doing it. This role exists because most reliability toil (triage, root-causing, remediation, SLO tracking, onboarding checks) is repetitive and well-defined enough to hand to an LLM-based agent with the right guardrails. Your job is to do the on-call/ops work like any SRE, then turn what you learn into agents - identify the workflow, build the agent, and earn the trust to let it act with increasing autonomy.
What you'll do

• Carry a normal on-call rotation and act as a hands-on responder: investigate, fix, and document incidents yourself, exactly like any SRE on the team - especially for workflows that don' t have an agent yet.

• Go deep on application-level reliability, not just infrastructure: read and debug service code, understand business logic well enough to find the real root cause, and ship fixes or PRs directly into application repos when the fix belongs in the app, not the platform.

• Design, build, and ship LLM-based agents (using tools like Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi K2/K3) that plug into our existing stack: Kubernetes, cloud APIs, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Datadog, PagerDuty/Slack.

• Define the "tool" interface each agent needs - the specific APIs, scripts, and read/write actions - and build safe wrappers around them.

• Set clear guardrails for every agent: what it may do autonomously vs. what it must propose for human approval, with a bias toward human-in-the-loop until an agent has earned trust.

• Own agent evaluation - define what "correct" and "safe" look like per agent, and build test/backtest suites against real historical incidents.

• Continuously tune prompts, context, and tool schemas as an agent' s scope grows.

• Partner with the SRE/platform team to find good agent candidates: repetitive, well-scoped, auditable workflows.

• Report on agent impact - MTTD/MTTR/MTTX movement, false positive/negative rates, and engineer-hours of toil removed.

• Keep a security- and compliance-first posture: audit trails for every autonomous action, least-privilege access to production, and alignment with Saudi data residency/regulatory requirements.

Requirements

• 3+ years building production software with LLMs - agentic workflows, tool/function calling, multi-step planning, RAG - not just personal use of a chat assistant.

• Hands-on experience shipping real work with an agentic coding tool such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi K2/K3.

• Strong Python (or similar) for building agent tooling, API wrappers, and orchestration.

• Real, hands-on SRE experience: comfortable being a primary on-call responder, running incident response, and doing root cause analysis under pressure - not just familiar with the concepts.

• Application-level debugging skill, not just infra: able to read a service' s codebase, trace a failure back to the actual line/logic causing it, and ship a fix yourself - SRE work here isn' t limited to restarting pods or scal

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
About Influur

Influur is reimagining how advertising works - through creators, data, and AI. Our mission is to make influencer marketing as measurable, predictable, and scalable as paid media - and we're building the tech that makes it possible. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by global brands, we're scaling fast across music, culture, and entertainment.

We're looking for an FP&A Analyst who's excited to build real financial modeling skills inside a fast-growing, AI-native finance team.

The Role

You'll work directly with the FP&A Lead, supporting budget tracking, financial modeling, and forecasting across Influur 's business lines. This is not a data-entry role - it's a seat where you'll learn real FP&A from the ground up: how to build models the right way, how to read what the numbers are actually saying, and how to turn that into decisions leadership can act on.

We're looking for someone who already has real modeling fundamentals - we're not here to teach the basics of a formula or what a balance sheet is. What we will teach is how to apply that foundation to budgeting, contingency planning, rebudget cycles, and investor-grade reporting. If you have the base and the hunger to grow into it, this is your seat.

Your Skillset:

Must-haves:

• 1-2 years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, financial consulting, or a closely related analytical role

• Real, demonstrable financial modeling fundamentals - you know how to build a model from scratch, with clean structure and documented assumptions, not just fill in a template

• Advanced (Intermediate) Excel / Google Sheets - formulas, structuring data, comfortable without a template

• Understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and how the three financial statements connect

• Strong attention to detail - you catch inconsistencies in data before they become errors

• English proficiency, B2 or above (written, spoken, and reading)

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or related field
Nice-to-haves:

• Exposure to multi-business-unit or multi-entity P&L environments

• Curiosity about AI tools applied to finance - you don't need to be an expert, but you're already experimenting

• Experience supporting investor reporting or board-level materials

• Startup or high-growth company experience

You're the Type Who:

• Has real modeling bases, but doesn't pretend to know everything - you want to be trained, and you're hungry to learn

• Takes ownership without being asked twice

• Is genuinely curious about AI - you already use it, even if you're not an expert, and you want to get better

• Pays obsessive attention to detail - a wrong formula or a mislabeled row bothers you until it's fixed

• Is comfortable with ambiguity - startups don't hand you a finished playbook

• Has a startup mindset: speed, resourcefulness, and comfort wearing more than one hat

First 90 days:

• Fully ramped on Influur 's financial structure, reporting cadence, and modeling standards

• Owns the monthly budget-vs-actuals tracking process independently

• Has contributed to at least one full rebudget cycle

• Shows growing fluency applying AI tools to real reporting and modeling workflows

What we offer:

• Remote work

• Direct mentorship from the FP&A Lead and CFO, with a clear growth path

• Real ownership from day one - your models inform board and investor decisions

• Opportunity to build modern, AI-assisted FP&A skills inside a real finance function

• A collaborative, high-ownership team environmen

title: Software Engineer
description:
Supporting Cast seeks a passionate, creative developer with PHP and agentic engineering experience to expand onSupporting Cast’s podcast subscription platform. As a key member of our team, you'll be helping independent creators, podcast publishers, and media companies improve their financial sustainability and better satisfy their fans. You'll be joining a small development team and will be in a position to influence our tech stack and our evolving product. Working here provides the dynamic excitement of a startup, and the stability and competitive compensation of an established employer.

We will consider candidates from anywhere in the United States, provided you can largely work East Coast hours-the role is fully remote.

About the Position

Opportunities:

• Learn a lot about the podcast industry and the rapidly growing paid subscription market

• Scale an application as we onboard clients with tens of thousands of members and evaluate new technologies

• Develop and maintain user- and administrator-facing features in our existing stack

• Help us leverage A.I. tools to accelerate new feature development and improve code quality and security

• Build and maintain implementations for other websites, including embeds and third-party integrations

Our Current Tech Stack:

•
App : PHP/Laravel, Nginx, Varnish, Redis, PostgreSQL, Docker, React

•
Dev ops : AWS, Fastly CDN

•
Key business vendors and partners: Stripe, Spotify, Wordpress

•
Key software vendors: Google Cloud Computing, AWS (SES/SNS/SMS), Anthropic

•
Repo: GitHub

•
Project management: Agile-oriented. Notion, Google Docs, Slack.

Requirements

• 1-3 years of professional experience with PHP and a PHP framework such as Laravel

• 1-2 years of experience with LLM-based A.I.

• Familiarity with programming fundamentals and industry best practices; a CS degree is a plus but not required

• Willingness to adapt and learn on the job

WHY JOIN SUPPORTING CAST?
You’ll help make workplaces more connected, informed, and interesting via the magic of podcasting. Supporting Cast built one of podcasting’s first and most successful subscription management platforms for top public podcasters before expanding to improve employee experiences at some of the most interesting companies in the world.
You’ll be the first hire for this function. This is a great opportunity if you want ownership of your work, a taste of startup life, and the responsibility of setting the bar high for a new team. You’ll also enjoy competitive salary and benefits in a remote-first, mission-driven, and family-friendly team.
About Supporting Cast:
Supporting Cast is a podcast monetization platform that helps top publishers and creators offer premium subscription content directly to listeners. Our clients include leading podcast publishers like NPR, SiriusXM, and NBC, along with major independent shows. A proponent of the open ecosystem, we make it seamless for subscribers to access premium podcast content in their favorite app-no new app to download-and give publishers the tools to grow and manage their paying audience with flexible integrations, analytics, and payments.
We’re a small, fully remote company with a strong belief in the future of audio. We’re looking for someone who is thoughtful and detail-oriented to help us bring the magic of podcasting into more corporate settings.
Supporting Cast is an affiliate of the Graham Holdings Company (NYSE:GHC). GHC is a diversified holding company whose operations include educational services; home health and hospice care; television broadcasting, online, print, and local TV news; automotive dealerships; manufacturing; hospitality; and consumer internet companies.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
ABOUT US

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

THE ROLE

As Finance Associate at Encord, you'll own the operational core of our finance function, including: supplier payments, customer invoicing, and month-end reconciliations - ensuring everything runs accurately and on time. You'll partner closely with the wider finance function and cross-functional teams across the business, helping make finance a great partner to the rest of the company. The day-to-day processes are yours to run and improve: where something is manual or unclear, you'll have the real opportunity to make it better. It's a strong fit for someone early in their finance career who takes ownership seriously and wants their work to underpin the teams building tools for multimodal AI.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable, VAT returns and accounts receivable.

- Process employee expense reports and ensure adherence to company policies.

- Oversee client invoicing and manage billing workflows.

- Assist with month-end close procedures, bank reconciliations, and general ledger maintenance.

- Support financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis.

- Collaborate on ad-hoc finance and operational projects as they arise.

 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Precision in the core. You take pride in managing the transactional heart of the company. You aren't just processing invoices or reconciling accounts; you view accuracy in bookkeeping and compliance as the critical foundation that allows us to move fast and make informed decisions.

- A builder of systems. You don’t just accept manual processes as status quo. Whether it’s improving expense workflows or refining billing, you look for the "better way" to do things, ensuring our financial systems scale as quickly as our business.

- Collaborative by nature. You recognize that effective finance isn’t a back-office function-it’s a partner to the business. You’re ready to bridge the gap between financial operations and the cross-functional teams building the tools for multimodal AI.

- Ready for high-growth ownership. You are early in your finance career, but you crave responsibility. You want a role where your daily output directly supports our growth, and you’re hungry for the professional development that comes from operating in a fast-paced environment.

 

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

- Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

- 1-2 years of experience in a finance, accounting, or analytical role (tech or startup experience is a plus, but not required).

- Solid foundational knowledge of bookkeeping, accounts payable/receivable, and invoicing.

- Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.

- Proficiency in spreadsheet software and financial tools. An understanding of AI-native finance stacks would be advantageous

- Proactive mindset with the ability to adapt in a fast-paced, growing environment.

 

WHY ENCORD

- Competitive salary, commission, and equity in a high-growth startup

- Strong in-person culture - most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

- 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

- Annual learning & development budget

- Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

- Company lunches twice a week

- Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

title: Lead CPA - Bill Pay & Tax Practice
description:
We're looking for a CPA who wants to build something - not from scratch, and not alone, but with the freedom to shape a practice the way it should be shaped.
Our firm provides integrated financial care to physician families across California and several other U.S. states. We currently serve hundreds of households, and we're adding to the ways we serve them.
Today, our clients' tax and bookkeeping needs are served through external partner firms we've worked with for years. That partnership has helped us get to where we are, and it will continue. At the same time, we see meaningful gaps we'd like to fill ourselves - starting with bill pay and straightforward tax preparation. We'd like you to lead that work.
WHAT YOU'D BE BUILDING
A premium, integrated practice that complements the financial planning our clients already receive from us. You'd start with a built-in client base, an established brand, and something most CPAs building a practice never get: a global team of seasoned client service associates who handle first contact and administrative support. That means your time goes to the craft and the client conversations, not to sales, marketing, recruiting, legal, nor IT.
The practice is designed to evolve with our clients' needs over time, and you'll have a meaningful voice in how it grows.
WHAT YOU'D DO

• Provide bill pay services for elders and high-net-worth client families

• Prepare straightforward personal tax returns, primarily for W-2 households

• Shape how the practice grows, including how we manage the natural seasonality of tax work

• Collaborate with other team leaders to design repeatable systems that fit within our existing framework. Fitting in with our processes is essential.

YOU'LL ALSO BRING YOUR EXPERTISE TO

• Helping clients keep their financial records organized and decision-ready

• Guiding clients through entity-related questions that come up in their financial lives

• Bringing a tax-informed perspective into our team's planning conversations

• Being a trusted, knowledgeable resource for clients on the financial details that matter to them

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Licensed CPA in good standing

• Meaningful experience in tax preparation, with some exposure to bookkeeping

• Drawn to the idea of designing a practice rather than inheriting one

• A clear, warm communicator who genuinely enjoys client relationships

• Comfortable working remotely and collaborating across time zones

• Interested in the physician niche, or excited to learn it deeply

HOW WE WORK
We've been a fully distributed company since 2013, and over the years we've built a global team of seasoned client service associates who handle first contact and administrative support for every advisor, including you. Our shared priority is to protect your time for online conversations with clients.
Compensation is negotiable and tailored to the right person. We're open to W-2 with bonus or 1099, depending on what fits your situation and goals.

description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is seeking a high impact Emulation Engineer to help bring our SiP based AI or ML engines to life through scalable, high performance emulation platforms. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on technical ownership, solves system level problems, and wants to influence silicon debug, DV, and performance from the ground up. Who You Are

• Bring 10+ years of SoC or ASIC experience, including a deep understanding of logic design, verification, and emulation platforms.

• Fluent in Verilog or SystemVerilog, C or C++, and SystemC, with hands-on experience using commercial emulators such as ZeBu, Palladium, or Veloce.

• Confident in architecting DV and emulation environments, from transactors to monitors to debug hooks, and automate everything you can.

• Collaborative and self driven, with a passion for mentoring junior engineers and working cross functionally with architecture, software, and DV teams.

• A passion to build and scale a multi chiplet emulation ecosystem that supports DV, software development, and power or performance debug.

• Comfort in developing testbenches, transactors, monitors, and support systems to enable high quality, high efficiency emulation usage.

• Experience in driving emulation coverage from functional and performance to low level software enablement, and automate as much of the flow as possible.

• To optimize the platform for frequency, resource sharing, and end user support, ensuring Tenstorrent teams get the most from emulation.

What You Will Learn

• Building an emulation flow that supports chiplet based SiPs at scale, spanning AI workloads, interconnects, and system level power.

• How Tenstorrent integrates AI engines, RISC V CPUs, die to die links, PCIe, UCIe, and memory controllers into one unified platform.

• To align virtual prototyping, power analysis, and emulation into a full stack validation solution.

• How emulation sits at the core of a cross functional silicon bring up strategy, from RTL to post silicon debug and customer delivery.

title: Freelancer: Projektmanager (m/w/d)
description:
[Bulle & Mensch] ist der deutschsprachige Video-Podcast über das echte Handwerk erfolgreicher Trader und Investoren: Setup, Psyche und der Mensch hinter den Entscheidungen.
Signale, Hypes und Lambo-Versprechen gibt es woanders. Bei uns sprechen Trading-Weltmeister, professionelle Investoren und Menschen mit außergewöhnlichen Erfolgsgeschichten offen über Strategien, Fehler, Rückschläge und das, was langfristig wirklich funktioniert.
Unser Ziel ist klar: Bis Ende 2027 wollen wir die reichweitenstärkste deutschsprachige Fin-Podcast-Marke werden - mit YouTube als Hauptplattform. Dafür wächst unser Team, und die Prozesse dahinter brauchen jemanden, der sie zusammenhält, vorantreibt und weiterdenkt.
Aufgaben
Als Projektmanager:in (m/w/d) bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Mario und allen laufenden Prozessen rund um [Bulle & Mensch]. Du sorgst dafür, dass Redaktion, Booking, Produktion, Social Media und Partnerschaften ineinandergreifen, Deadlines eingehalten werden und nichts liegen bleibt.
Dabei bist du nicht nur Prozesshüter:in, sondern Treiber:in: Du behältst den Überblick über das Gesamtprojekt, erkennst, wo es hakt, und schiebst Themen aktiv an - auch wenn sie noch niemand explizit an dich delegiert hat. Genauso wichtig ist der zweite Teil der Rolle: Du identifizierst neue Projekte und Wachstumschancen für [Bulle & Mensch], bringst sie strukturiert auf die Schiene und begleitest sie von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.
Du arbeitest eng mit Mario und den Freelancer:innen im Team zusammen, führst Fäden zusammen, die sonst lose blieben, und sorgst mit klaren Strukturen dafür, dass gute Ideen nicht in internen Abstimmungsschleifen untergehen.
Deine Aufgaben

• Laufende Prozesse rund um Redaktion, Booking, Produktion, Social Media und Partnerschaften koordinieren und weiterentwickeln

• Deadlines, Verantwortlichkeiten und offene Punkte im Blick behalten und proaktiv nachfassen

• Bestehende Abläufe (u. a. in Notion) dokumentieren, vereinfachen und für das Team verständlich halten

• Freelancer:innen und Teammitglieder koordinieren, Aufgaben verteilen und Fortschritt nachhalten

• Engpässe, Doppelarbeit und blinde Flecken im Projekt frühzeitig erkennen und lösen

• Neue Projektideen (Formate, Kooperationen, Kanäle, Tools) identifizieren, bewerten und strukturiert aufsetzen

• Neue Projekte von der ersten Idee über die Planung bis zur Umsetzung begleiten und dabei die Verantwortung behalten, bis sie laufen

• Regelmäßig mit Mario den Gesamtstatus des Projekts abstimmen und Prioritäten vorschlagen

Qualifikation

• Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Medien-, Content- oder Startup-Umfeld

• Fähigkeit, aus vielen losen Enden eine klare Struktur mit Prioritäten und Deadlines zu machen

• Eigenständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise - du musst nicht angeschoben werden, du schiebst selbst an

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, sicheres Sprachgefühl in der Kommunikation mit Team und Partnern

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Tools wie KI Agenten oder Notion

• Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Personen und Aufgaben zusammenzuführen

• Offenheit für direktes Feedback sowie die Fähigkeit, Entscheidungen klar zu begründen

Benefits
Du übernimmst nicht nur Verwaltung - du hältst das Projekt zusammen und treibst sein Wachstum aktiv mit.

•
Echte Verantwortung: Du bekommst nicht nur Aufgaben zugewiesen, sondern gestaltest mit, wie das Projekt organisiert wird und wohin es sich entwickelt.

•
Klares, ambitioniertes Ziel: Reichweite ist bis Ende 2027 die zentrale Priorität. Gute Ideen verschwinden bei uns nicht hinter internen Abstimmungsschleifen.

•
Außergewöhnliches Ausgangsmaterial: Lange, ungeschönte Gespräche mit erfolgreichen Tradern, Investoren, Unternehmern und Finanzpersönlichkeiten liefern Substanz statt austauschbarer Content-Häppchen.

•
Eigene KI-Innovation: Mit Frag [Bulle & Mensch] haben wir einen eigenen KI-Podcast-Assistenten entwickelt.

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Team

The Security Engineering team's mission is to safeguard our AI systems and maintain the trust of our users and society at large. Whether we're developing critical security infrastructure, building secure development practices, or partnering with our research and product teams, we are committed to operating as a world-class security organization and keeping the safety and trust of our users at the forefront of everything we do.

What You’ll Do:

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in red teaming and offensive security operations

• Deep expertise in at least two of: macOS security, Linux Security, Cloud security (GCP/AWS/Azure), Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines

• Prior work at organizations with state actor threat models

title: Senior SMM
description:

Зараз ми шукаємо Senior SMM Manager , який стане власником напряму соціальних мереж для двох брендів компанії: DID Global та DG Partners. Основні завдання

• Розробка та реалізація комплексної SMM-стратегії для кількох брендів компанії.

• Побудова та розвиток соціальних мереж практично з нуля.

• Створення контент-планів, контентних рубрик та механік залучення аудиторії.

• Робота з Instagram, LinkedIn, Telegram, Threads, X (Twitter) та іншими релевантними платформами.

• Пошук нових точок росту та тестування гіпотез для збільшення охоплень і залучення цільової аудиторії.

• Аналіз ефективності контенту, підготовка звітності та впровадження покращень на основі даних.

• Організація та запуск колаборацій із партнерами, інфлюенсерами та профільними медіа.

• Участь у просуванні компанії через галузеві заходи, конференції та івенти.

• Співпраця з дизайнерами, маркетологами та іншими учасниками команди.

• Побудова внутрішніх процесів SMM-напряму та подальше формування команди.

Наш ідеальний кандидат

• Має від 3 років досвіду в SMM.

• Має успішний досвід розвитку B2B-проєктів.

• Має досвід побудови SMM-напряму з нуля.

• Розуміє, як працює органічне зростання аудиторії та побудова ком'юніті.

• Вміє працювати не лише з контентом, а й з аналітикою та бізнес-метриками.

• Має досвід роботи з міжнародними ринками.

• Розуміє специфіку Tech, Telecom, SaaS, Affiliate або суміжних ніш.

• Володіє англійською мовою на рівні від B1.

• Знає алгоритми та особливості розвитку Instagram, LinkedIn, Telegram, Threads та X.

• Має досвід роботи з аналітикою соціальних мереж.

• Самостійно приймає рішення та несе відповідальність за результат.

• Бачить соціальні мережі як інструмент розвитку бізнесу, а не лише як майданчик для публікації контенту.

Буде перевагою

• Досвід управління командою або бажання розвиватися до керівної ролі.

• Досвід участі в міжнародних виставках, конференціях та галузевих заходах.

• Досвід роботи з Reddit, Quora та іншими альтернативними платформами просування.

• Навички роботи з таргетованою рекламою.

Що ти отримаєш у цій ролі

• Професійний розвиток за рахунок компанії. Оплачуємо профільні курси, навчальні програми та консультації з лідерами індустрії.

• Ріст до Head of SMM. Зможеш поступово сформувати власну команду, очолити напрям і відповідати за його розвиток.

• Побудова власної медійності. Допоможемо розвивати особистий бренд, створювати експертний контент і ставати впізнаваним фахівцем у своїй ніші.

• Міжнародний досвід. Робота з B2B-аудиторією та брендами у сферах Tech, Telecom і Affiliate, а також потенційні закордонні відрядження на конференції, виставки та зйомки.

• Свобода для сильних ідей. Тут можна тестувати гіпотези, запускати нові формати та пропонувати сміливі рішення без багаторівневого погодження кожного кроку.

• Корпоративні курси англійської мови , щоб впевнено працювати з міжнародними командами та аудиторіями.

• Mental Health Day Off . Додатковий вихідний, коли потрібно перезавантажитися та повернути собі ресурс.

• Тімбілдинги . У нас є заміський будинок, де ми проводимо командні виїзди, внутрішні події та просто якісно відпочиваємо разом.

• Менеджмент без зайвого мікроконтролю. Ми цінуємо самостійність, відповідальність та результат, а не кількість повідомлень у робочому чаті.

• Ну і само собою щедрий пакет відпусток, лікарняних та day-off .

description:
🌎 WHAT WE DO

ROOT IS EUROPE’S #1 PRIMARY DATA COLLECTION PLATFORM FOR F&B COMPANIES. WE HELP OUR CUSTOMERS TO MEASURE AND REDUCE FARM-LEVEL EMISSIONS.

~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Unlike other industries, the vast majority of F&B emissions originate from farms (known as Scope 3.1 emissions) and are highly complex to address. Root exists to help overcome this challenge.

We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early-stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀

🔭 WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

Your mission

Drive customer success by supporting a customer portfolio, ensuring smooth project execution and tool adoption, and helping build strong, trust-based relationships that maximize long-term value and advocacy.

📅 Over the next months, you will…

Drive Customer Success and Long-Term Value for Root's Customers

- Own the success of a defined customer portfolio, acting as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor, guiding customers through key success milestones (onboarding, data collection, verification, reporting, reduction readiness) and ensuring they clearly understand and realize the value of the Root Platform

- Plan, manage, and execute customer projects end-to-end, driving primary data coverage at scale through increased user engagement and data completion, serving as the first point of contact for agricultural users when needed, and ensuring high data quality, clear milestones, and on-time delivery

- Design and run farmer-facing enablement, including digital webinars to drive participation, improve data quality, and build trust at the farm level

- Collaborate with Account Management to relay customer feedback while building trust-based customer relationships that drive long-term satisfaction, retention, and advocacy

- Collaborate with Product to bring agricultural and agronomic expertise into our products, translating practical farming knowledge and farmer needs into actionable product feedback and clear, farmer-facing recommendations.

🧺 What you bring along

- Agricultural background (practical farm experience, agricultural studies, or prior work with agricultural users such as advisors, cooperatives)
